name: Hivi
overview: Hivi is a male figure identified as a son of Canaan, belonging to the tribe of the Hivites. His mention is primarily genealogical, establishing his place within the descendants of Canaan. There are no additional notes or unique attributes beyond his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Hivi appears as a proper name in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin provided. It is simply recorded as the name of this individual in Genesis 10:17.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Hivi as a son of Canaan, linking him to the broader family of Canaan's descendants. Additionally, Hamor is noted as an ancestor of the Hivites, which connects Hivi to this lineage by inference. No other family relationships are detailed.
scriptureSignificance: Hivi's significance lies in his role as a progenitor of the Hivite tribe, which is part of the broader narrative of the nations descending from Canaan. This genealogical placement helps to trace the origins of the peoples inhabiting the land promised to Abraham's descendants. Through Hivi and his descendants, the biblical text outlines the complex ethnic and tribal landscape encountered by Israel.
